sentences.text: This giant penguin measured 1.8 meters long and weighed 90 kilograms.
It also stood 1.7 meters tall, with some estimates suggesting a maximum weight of 90 kilograms.
It holds the record for the largest penguin species of the Eocene epoch.
One specific specimen is estimated to have reached a body length of 2.05 meters and a weight of 108 kilograms.
The genus was first described by Wiman in 1905.
Anthropornis is classified within the family Spheniscidae.
Fossils have been found in the La Meseta Formation on Seymour Island off Antarctica and in New Zealand.
Its time range is recorded as the Bartonian to Burdigalian stages, from 41.03 to 15.98 million years ago.
